query:
SELECT b."name" AS "name!", COALESCE(SUM(t."amount"), 0) AS "total!: i64"
             FROM "Budget" b
             LEFT JOIN "Transaction" t
               ON t."budgetId" = b."id" AND t."type" = 'EXPENSE'
              AND t."date" >= ?1 AND t."date" <= ?2
            WHERE b."name" IN ('Healthcare', 'Medicine')
            GROUP BY b."name"
